Need parse instructions: categories:
- STANCE_MAINTAINED: both respond to same specific proposition with same stance.
- STANCE_REVERSED: same specific proposition with opposite stance.
- INCOMPARABLE: both have determinable position, but do not respond to same specific proposition.
- RELATION_UNCERTAIN: some step (determinability, comparability or stance) not sufficiently clear.
- INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: at least one manifestation has no determinable position on any specific proposition.
